He enjoys solving operational challenges, improving processes and helping businesses scale sustainably. He thrives in environments that value ownership, collaboration and continuous learning.

Originally from Zimbabwe and now based in Portugal, Ahmed studied in South Africa before beginning his career at a fast-growing recruitment and HR company. She believes that when individuals feel able to show up honestly, communicate openly, and trust one another, both people and organisations thrive. What motivates her most are the moments when things truly shift: lightbulb moments, changes in perspective, and the cultural impact that follows. originally considered becoming a teacher, but while exploring university options, she discovered occupational psychology, a field that she very quickly became deeply passionate about. body: What Drives Him

Alvaro has a passion for problem solving and improving areas of the business, whether that is re-structuring an existing capability or building one from scratch, he is happiest when tackling a complex puzzle and working with motivated and talented people around him. A firm believer of developing people and putting them first, he believes that doing right by people will have long-term organisational benefits. A huge believer in the power of ‘us’ and not ‘I’ he believes that you can get more done and have more fun when working as a cohesive team. With an interest in all thing’s leadership, he also gets a lot out of developing his teams and watching them thrive, both personally and professionally.
Backstory and Achievements
Originally from New Zealand, he has also lived and worked in Australia and the UK.

Although his career started down the medical route, a career diversion led him to pursue all things business. Before starting at Laminar he has primarily worked for the UK MOD as an internal business consultant, working on and leading a range of consultancy projects, from digitalisation programmes through to the restructuring of military police and establishing a new human performance capability for the Army, he has been involved across the enterprise on multiple high-profile projects.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Applied Science
• Integrated Masters/Bachelor (Hons) of Health and Medical Science
• Master of Business Administration (MBA)
Fun Facts
• Speaks English and Spanish.
• Loves all things golf, Real Madrid and of course, the All Blacks.
What Drives Him

Alwyn is driven by the opportunity to help people find a place where they can truly flourish. Seeing the individuals he hires grow, thrive, and do their best work within an organization that values them is one of the most rewarding parts of his role in Talent Acquisition.

Alwyn is equally passionate about continuous learning and growth. He believes that staying curious and committed to self-development not only strengthens him professionally but also enables him to better support others in reaching their potential.

At the heart of everything is his family. As a family-oriented person, he values meaningful relationships and cherishes time spent with loved ones. That balance fuels the purpose and energy he brings to his work every day.
Backstory and Achievements

Alwyn’s background in Talent Acquisition is grounded in strategic sourcing and building strong talent pipelines. With experience spanning both in-house and agency recruitment, he brings a well-rounded perspective to identifying and attracting top talent.

He has supported hiring across multiple industries and functional domains, including IT and Engineering, People, Finance, Sales and Customer Success, and Marketing. His expertise covers end-to-end recruitment— ensuring a seamless and thoughtful hiring experience for both candidates and stakeholders.
Formal Qualifications
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, Major in Human Resource Management
Fun Facts

An athletic foodie at heart, Alwyn enjoys staying active just as much as he enjoys exploring new restaurants and coffee shops. He’s always on the lookout for his next great meal — especially if there’s a good burger involved.

What Drives Her

Diana is all about meaningful connections – the kind that make life feel less like a puzzle and more like a story worth telling. Helping others navigate life’s challenges is what drives her! She believes that everyone has the potential to shine, even in the darkest moments, and being part of that transformation is what gets her out of bed every morning (well, that and coffee!). Her love for learning and working with people from all walks of life keeps her curious, inspired, and always ready for the next adventure.
Backstory and Achievements

Diana’s journey as a psychologist has been anything but dull. It began over a decade ago in Portugal, and since then, she has travelled through countries, cultures, and roles, collecting unforgettable experiences along the way. In 2014, she stepped out of her comfort zone and spent six transformative months in Mozambique, working on community projects that taught her resilience and highlighted the shared humanity that connects us all.

Her UK chapter followed, where Diana wore multiple hats: Counselling and Health Psychologist, Expert Witness, Trainer, and even Healthcare Assistant. She worked in fascinating, albeit challenging, environments like immigration removal centres, where she conducted psychological assessments and drafted psychological reports for court cases. On the other side of the spectrum, she supported individuals facing end-of-life conditions, helping them and their families find comfort and meaning during life’s most vulnerable moments.

These experiences have shaped Diana’s appreciation for the incredible strength of the human spirit – whether it’s in navigating adversity or embracing the beauty of life’s final chapter. What’s next for Diana? She hopes to volunteer in a refugee camp, combining her expertise in trauma-focused care with her passion for making a difference.
Formal Qualifications
• Master’s in clinical and health psychology – because learning about the human mind and behaviour is endlessly fascinating!
• Post-graduate degree in Neuropsychological Assessment and Rehabilitation – decoding the brain’s mysteries, one test at a time.
• Excellence in Report Writing – Diana has a knack for turning complex cases into reports that lawyers actually want to read!
Fun Facts
• Diana has a twin sister, and yes, they’ve definitely played the “which twin is which” game more than once.
• While living in the UK, she became that person who paints pebbles with uplifting messages and leaves them in random places – spreading smiles, one rock at a time.
• Crafts are her thing – from handmade gifts to random DIY projects, Diana loves turning a simple idea into something tangible.
• She’s passionate about travelling, immersing herself in new cultures, and exploring different cuisines.

Evelyn has an open and sociable nature and tends to create a positive environment around her. As a Talent Sourcer with experience in connecting with people, she is driven by empathy and a desire to help individuals grow professionally. An optimist at heart, her focus on potential makes her adept at understanding and supporting talent. She believes in the power of positive impact and brings an energetic approach to a team.

Evelyn's initial professional experience was in the Tourism industry, following her studies in Geography and Tourism. After a year in the field, the pandemic led to her transition into Talent Acquisition. Juliana also finds great satisfaction in supporting her colleagues, helping them overcome challenges and achieve their aspirations.
For her, these moments of facilitating success and growth in others are the true markers of the meaningful difference she aims to make in the lives of those around her.

Juliana's roots trace back to East-Timor, but for the better part of her life, she has lived, studied, and built her career in Portugal.

Juliana kicked off her career journey back in 2015 at a small HR consultancy firm, where she quickly discovered her knack for recruitment and has been in the game ever since. With a solid foundation in both agency and in-house recruitment teams, she's dipped her toes in various sectors – from IT and Life Sciences to BPO, Crypto, and now she's hoping to make waves in Construction/Business Consultancy over at Laminar.

But the highlight of Juliana's career was the time she built a Sourcing Hub from the ground up at Kelly Services. She handpicked and trained a stellar team, steering them to productivity without micromanaging, ensuring they kept their independence every step of the way.

• BSc in Psychology

Juliana was nicknamed "Sopa" in school, which means "soup" in Portuguese, all thanks to a soup that shared her name. When she's not working, you can find her hanging out with her family and friends, throwing punches in Muay Thai to beat stress, binge-watching true crime docs, or getting lost in thriller books on her Kindle. Kalina is highly motivated by working for mission-driven companies and by collaborating with people who inspire her with their passion and deep knowledge of their subject. She thrives in diverse environments where individuals are free to express their thoughts, ideas, and creativity- believing that this is where the best ideas are born.

Kalina was born and raised in Bulgaria but moved to Edinburgh, Scotland, to pursue a degree in Public Relations and Marketing. After working in events management and media relations for the Edinburgh International Festival, she moved to London to join one of the largest management consultancies as a Global Marketing Specialist. Since then, she has worked in tech, micromobility, and data & AI recruitment - specialising in strategic B2B growth marketing. Her accomplishments include launching a successful podcast, growing a data & AI newsletter to over 200k subscribers, and organising hundreds of events.
On a personal level, moving abroad alone at a young age and her travels remain her proudest achievements to date.

Kalina holds a BA in Public Relations and Marketing and a diploma in Digital Marketing. She is currently upskilling in SQL, machine learning and python.

Kalina is a trained opera singer, an active reggaeton dancer and a passionate traveller. With the aim to visit at least half of the world’s countries, she tries to explore at least 2 new countries every year!

One of her proudest accomplishments is founding the KAAGAPAY: Free Community Mental Health Program, which provides access to psychological services in remote areas of her province (Batangas). This initiative reflects her heart for service and her mission to bring mental health support closer to those who need it most.

Magdalena is passionate about people and firmly believes they are the cornerstone of any successful team. She plays a vital role in placing individuals where they can thrive, develop, and feel valued. An eternal optimist, Magdalena adapts creatively when faced with challenges. Originally from Poland, Magdalena has spent a significant portion of her life working and living in the UK before eventually settling in Portugal. With over a decade of experience in talent acquisition, she's gained extensive expertise in global recruitment and talent management. Her corporate career spans various industries, including retail, chemical, and automotive manufacturing. Now, she's dedicated to transforming the recruitment world for the better.

What Drives Her

Mahjalin Araiza Diez is a clinical psychologist, psychometrician, and educator dedicated to making mental health more accessible and meaningful. She ranked in the Top 5 in the board exam for psychologists—a testament to her deep understanding of the field and commitment to excellence.

As a clinical psychologist, she provides compassionate and evidence-based support to individuals navigating emotional challenges. She has also been a well-loved college professor, known for her engaging teaching style and ability to connect with students on a personal level.
Backstory and Achievements

For her dissertation, Mahjalin developed the MAPANATAG Program (Mindful Attunement-Based Parenting Approach to Nurture, Alleviate, Teach, Advocate, and Guide), a culturally sensitive, needs-based parenting intervention for first-time Filipino parents with a history of childhood emotional maltreatment. The program empowers parents to become nurturing, confident caregivers, helping them overcome self-doubt and ultimately feel mapanatag—reassured and at peace.
Rooted in the same advocacy, Mahjalin founded Kasama MH & Psychosocial Services, a community-based clinic that offers inclusive and compassionate mental health support for individuals and families.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Arts – Psychology
• Master of Science in Clinical Psychology
• Doctor of Philosophy
Fun Facts

Beyond her clinical work, Mahjalin is a sought-after speaker, sharing insights on compassion fatigue, resilience, trauma, and identity in the digital age. Her talks are known for being relatable, insightful, and grounded in both research and real-life experiences. She believes that healing starts with genuine connection—whether in therapy, the classroom, or a meaningful conversation over coffee.

Despite her many roles, Mahjalin remains deeply human. She enjoys music, playing guitar, and singing as a personal outlet. True to her name—“Mahal-in” (to love)—she leads with heart, offering kindness, wisdom, and unwavering support to those who need it most.

If there is such thing as a mission in life, Rute believes that hers has to do with helping others develop and become a better version of themselves - she thinks there is nothing more beautiful than seeing other person bloom.
Learning new things is Rute’s favorite hobby, whether it's to improve her professional skills or the personal ones.

After graduating, Rute worked as a clinical psychologist at a therapeutic community, with adolescents with substance use problems, and then she was one of the coordinators at a foster care home for children and adolescents. She also developed her private practice working with children, adolescents and adults.

Since moving to London, she has built her career at the intersection of information management and digital transformation, helping public and private sector clients harness data, technology, and collaboration to unlock value, streamline delivery, and embed smarter, more connected ways of working.
Formal Qualifications
• MSc in Civil Engineering
• Postgraduate master’s in information management
Fun Facts
• She’s happiest when she’s on the move—whether it’s a barre class, a yoga flow, or chasing down a new hiking trail.
• A self-confessed podcast addict, she always has one playing in the background, fuelling her curiosity and love of learning.
What Drives Him

Isaac is driven to “doing the basics well.” Takes pride in seeing a plan being executed and delivered in a timely manner. Feels that communication and a positive work environment are integral to success. Future personal/career orientated goals:
• Wants to be involved in driving the construction industry into more sustainable practices.
• Learn 4D Modelling.
• More involvement within Shape & Power BI
• Learn a 2 nd Language.
• Run Another Marathon
Backstory and Achievements

Originally from Burnley (Lancashire), Isaac followed a thirst for travel after University. Picking up a role as a Project Coordinator in Sydney 2017. From there, Isaac was thrust into the world of Planning & Scheduling. Since then, he has worked at both Contractor & Consultancy level – involved on multiple projects across: Australia, New Zealand, UK & Canada ranging from Civils Infrastructure, Rail to Hi-Rise & Residential.
Formal Qualifications

Isaac holds a Bachelor’s Degree in English Language & Sociology graduating from the University of Sheffield in 2015. Following a spell of work & travel, he pursued a qualification in HNC Lvl 4 Construction in the Built Environment. The latest qualification was completing a CPD Certified course from the London South Bank University in Sustainable Construction & Development.
Fun Facts
• Completed Manchester Marathon. Planning Milan Half Marathon in March 25
• Padel Enthusiast
• Yomping around the world for 2 years across: Australia, New Zealand, Nepal, Philippines and Vietnam.
• Currently learning Italian and Spanish
Coming soon
What Drives Her

For Jam, success is about mutual growth—ensuring that both she and the people around her become better and feel accomplished together. She has a strong desire to experiment and explore different approaches to understand how things work. She believes that by testing various scenarios, she can gain deeper insights and make more informed decisions that lead to better outcomes. She is also passionate about leading and mentoring, and she always strives to build genuine relationships to help others improve.
Backstory and Achievements

Born and raised in the Philippines, Jam has six years of experience in the construction industry, specifically in the commercial, managing projects from preconstruction tenders to the construction phase. Together with her team, she led the procurement of work packages for residential buildings, as well as cost control, change and contract management, risk assessment, and productivity analysis. Collaborating closely with project managers and planning engineers, she ensured projects were delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality of standards.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering
Fun Facts
• A certified coffee addict who loves geeking out over espresso machines, the origins of coffee beans, and their unique flavor notes.
• Passionate about cooking and baking.
• Enjoys planning and organizing events, whether it's a birthday celebration, an out-of-town trip, or even a wedding—name it!
• A road trip enthusiast and avid traveller.
• Jam is also fond of self-help books.
Coming soon
What Drives Her

Janina is passionately curious and constantly strives for both professional and personal growth. She aims to use this enthusiasm towards improving project delivery and innovation in the construction industry.
Backstory and Achievements

Born and currently living in the Philippines, she started her career at the largest construction company in the country. She has worked through different roles in seven years, from the field to design work. She contributed to a variety of large-scale projects such as commercial and residential buildings, infrastructure, and various temporary works.

Before joining Laminar, she was the methods officer for a premiere residential project located in the country’s financial hub. She led and managed the Methods Team in delivering safe and efficient methodologies for the temporary works and construction of 58-storey and 72-storey towers.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering with specialisation in Structural Engineering
Fun Facts
• Janina is passionate about music and photography.
• She enjoys watching football and is a Real Madrid fan.
What Drives Him

Jasper is driven by continuous learning and growth. He is also passionate about analysing complex data which he approaches with technical, collaborative, and organisational skills and use of project management softwares. He is motivated by the idea that every day is an opportunity to be better.
Backstory and Achievements

Before joining Laminar Projects, Jasper worked for three years in a local construction firm, and a year with an international consulting firm. His career mostly focused on project management under project planning and controls.

He handled three projects under the local company he worked with – a mall, hotel, and a residential tower, all located at the heart of the Metro. He was involved in the creation of project execution plans and assisted project managers in ensuring timelines and revenue from design, procurement, and construction stages of the project.

As for the international consulting firm, he carried out supporting tasks such as project updating, progress tracking, and EOT evaluation for various projects in several international business areas such as residential buildings, data centres, schools, and commercial buildings.

With these experiences he was able to maximise his skills in using project management softwares like Primavera P6, MS Projects, and MS Excel, as well as presentation-related tools such as MS PowerBI and PowerPoint for an efficient delivery of outputs for clients and counterparts.
Formal Qualifications
• Licensed Civil Engineer
Fun Facts
• Jasper is a novice in portrait sketching.
• He's interested in sports – basketball and little bit of baseball.
• He has a soft spot for cats.
What Drives Him

Javier is a delivery project manager who is also a strong project planning and controls professional. This makes him particularly effective at driving projects forward using data-driven decision-making. He's all about delivery and using every tool at his disposal to make it happen.
Backstory and Achievements
• Originally from Spain, Javier has spent most of his career in the UK, where he's been a construction engineer and planning manager on projects ranging from £1 million to £1 billion.
• He's previously worked for Amey and the Alstom TSO Costain JV on Crossrail.
• His career progression has been rapid because he really takes delivery personally. He usually finds himself deputised by the project manager to both plan and drive delivery.
Formal Qualifications
• Master's in of Aeronautical Engineering
• Project Management Institute (PMI)
• PMP Certified
Fun Facts
• Javier speaks English and Spanish.
• He enjoys climbing and completing triathlons as well as rock and piano music.
Coming soon
What Drives Him

Jay is enthusiastic about self-development and is continuously looking for ways to develop on a personal and professional level, implementing a raw determination for self-teaching and absorbing experiences and knowledge from the distinguished colleagues he is surrounded by. Jay hopes to develop into a chartered Building Services Engineer focusing on sustainability, and to implement this with precise project planning to positively impact the construction industry and create a brighter future for the next generations.
Backstory and Achievements

From the City of Bradford in England, Jay has spent two years working within site-based roles at the start of his career both within the UK and overseas in Australia. Prior to joining Laminar, he had spent three and a half years working for a big Engineering Consultancy, designing Mechanical Building Services systems on different projects from prisons, process manufacturing facilities and laboratories. ‍

He also played a role in the design and BIM delivery of the mechanical services for the Clean Cow project in Scotland (to be built), a facility under construction to produce food additives for cattle that significantly reduces their associated CO2 production. Jay is currently in his 4th year of part time studies alongside full-time work.
Formal Qualifications
HNC – Construction and the Built Environment
Fun Facts
• Loves spending time with the family and adventuring the outdoors.
• He is a qualified Royal Yachting Association crew member with aspirations to become a Skipper, and eventually an Ocean Yacht Master.
What Drives Him
Jay loves the built environment, and finds himself constantly in awe of the designs, processes and materials which are continually pushing the boundaries of modern construction.

Loving a challenge, Jay strives to implement these groundbreaking initiatives and learn as much as he can from any project, whilst working to maximise construction efficiencies, minimising unnecessary wastage and maintaining project budgets.
Waking up and not knowing what each day will bring is one of the most exciting aspects of the construction industry for Jay, and he is always looking forward to learning something new.
Backstory and Achievements

Coming from Melbourne, Australia, Jay has spent almost a decade working in the commercial construction industry over a broad range of Tier 1, 2 and 3 projects, ranging from small industrial facilities, to $1.2b flagship shopping centres.

Over this period Jay has jumped at every opportunity to learn new skills, resulting inexperience in a wide range of roles, including Estimating, Contract Administration, OHS Management, Project Coordination and Site Management andSite Supervision.
Jay moved to Berlin in April 2024 and is looking forward to furthering his construction journey in Europe.
Formal Qualifications

Jay's Industry experience began back in 2011, when he started a summer job as a Document Controller with a tier 1 company. Impressed with his work ethic Jay was invited to stay on by the company directors and moved into a full-time role where he worked across a wide range of departments.

Since then, Jay has never looked back, and has successfully operated in almost every construction management role, culminating in his most recent position as Site Manager of several multi-million dollar developments where he personally managed site teams of up to 100 tradespeople.
Fun Facts

• Prior to moving to Europe, Jay bought a very old house in Melbourne and renovated it himself. What started as an optimistic 1-year project, turned into 2.5-years and resulted in a completely new structure, floors, ceilings and back wall (to name a few), all whilst he was still living in it.
• Outside of construction, Jay loves multi-day hiking, skiing and almost any outdoor activity.
• Jay also loves travelling and is still coming to terms with how close everything is in Europe compared to Australia!
What Drives Him

Jay is driven by helping others in delivering a successful project, whether through using his programming skills to automate tasks or devising project controls solutions provide the right data at the right time to make decisions.

On any project he works on, he aims to form lasting relationships, grounded in respect, honesty, and trust. From a technical side, he prioritises setting things up correctly over pursuing short-term success, focusing on creating solutions that offer benefits for the long-term.
Backstory and Achievements

Originally from Luxembourg, Jay has spent about half of his life living abroad. After studying Project Management in Ireland and England, he started working as a project scheduler / planner on some major public infrastructure projects in London. Being multilingual proved to be very beneficial when he moved Germany to work on one of Germany's biggest engineering projects. With his experience working in and setting up project controls functions he's able to develop flexible solutions that anticipate projects' future needs.
Formal Qualifications
• MSc TechnologyManagement
• BSc Project Management
• APMP Qualification (IPMALevel D)
Fun Facts
• Moved into his grand-dad's 200 year old house and started renovating it room by room. Learning as he goes along from YouTube and asking lots of questions.
• Loves rock climbing, being in nature and expanding his woodworking workshop.
What Drives Her

Jessica is fueled by her desire in helping build things that benefit her community. She is passionate in finding optimal solutions to problems and likes to create efficient ways of doing things. She finds joy in learning and considers her self a forever student of life. She believes in the power of collaborative effort and team work as she is inspired to share her knowledge and skills to other people.
Backstory and Achievements

Raised in the Philippines, Jessica started her engineering career in the construction industry as a planner. She was privileged to be part of huge construction firms that execute major government projects in Manila. She handled multiple infrastructure projects, particularly railway and elevated highway construction. She has also led training programs for planning and project management for novice and aspiring planners in her previous organizations.
Formal Qualifications
She finished her degree of BS in Industrial Engineering and acquired certifications in Primavera P6 and TILOS Linear Scheduling software for construction projects.
Fun Facts

Jessica is a jump rope enthusiast and loves doing jump rope exercises and tricks as away of keeping an active lifestyle. As a food-lover and adventure-seeker, she also loves travelling to new places and experiencing different cultures.
What Drives Her

Jill is driven by a quiet yet powerful balance of bold ambition and thoughtful intuition. There is a natural spark within her that pushes her to take initiative, face challenges head-on, and keep moving forward, yet she does so with a calm awareness of the people and environment around her. She doesn’t simply chase goals; she pursues them with purpose, care, and a desire to create harmony along the way. This combination of courage and sensitivity fuels her growth, allowing her to lead when needed, adapt with ease, and continuously refine herself—not just for success, but to create a meaningful and lasting impact.
Backstory and Achievements

With over six years of experience in the construction industry, Jill has developed a strong track record in project management and controls, successfully delivering a diverse portfolio of projects across both domestic and international markets. Her work spans residential and commercial land development, large-scale infrastructure, data centers, gigafactories, and energy and resource initiatives, where she consistently drives efficiency through structured project control systems, advanced tools, and streamlined workflows. Having operated within both PMO and PMC environments, she brings a balanced perspective that integrates governance with practical execution. Beyond her technical expertise, she is recognized for her leadership in building and mentoring multidisciplinary teams, enabling high-performing project delivery across regions. She has also contributed to business growth by helping secure new project awards while strengthening organizational capability.
Formal Qualifications
Jill holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering and is a licensed Civil Engineer in the Philippines.
Fun Facts
• Hobbies: Enjoys travelling, trying different cuisines, and discovering new music.

What Drives Her

Joana is an ambitious and motivated person that loves a good challenge. She is passionate about innovative technologies and looks forward to updates and releases of new software that can be used to improve processes, decision making and for automation.
She loves to make a positive difference in the world, using her skills and data passion to develop solutions to help solve real life problems.
Backstory and Achievements

Joana started her career as a data consultant in Portugal delivering end-to-end full stack solutions for clients from a wide range of industries ranging from commercial sector to public gov. She quickly realised her talents lay in helping translate real world client problems from business requirements to rich interactive data models and user-friendly visually compelling data visualisations – thereby specialising in the Power BI platform.

While in the UK, she has continued her career, working on multiple innovative projects, refining and developing these skills further, with deeper knowledge of the Microsoft data platform and the use of wider tooling. She is especially proud of a digital twin proof of concept that enabled simulation scenarios to be run to predict the potential effect of industrial on fish populations which was awarded a global award prize by her company.
Formal Qualifications
• MSc & BSc Industrial Engineering and Management, University of Porto, Portugal
• Numerous Microsoft Certifications such as PL-300 Power BI Data Analyst Associate
Fun Facts
• Joana loves animals and she is a proud dog parent to Maia, an energy packed and lovely Cockerpoo. She is also a self-confessed board game geek, owning a big collection of board games.
• Joana loves a good book and was able to read 40 books in a single year. She is unsure whether she can repeat the achievement.

What Drives Him
Jona is driven by a strong desire to develop both himself as well as the people around him always keen to try new approaches and ideas to improve outcomes and drive our industry forward.

Having worked with many smaller contractors he is driven by the desire to make the digitisation of the construction industry accessible to all. Simplifying the platforms to make them accessible to all while retaining their function.
Backstory and Achievements

Jona is originally from Germany but moved to the UK as a teenager through this he developed a real thirst for knowledge and innovation. After school and a degree in engineering, he went on to be a Digital engineer.
In his role there he was involved in many different projects around the UK employing modern data acquisition and visualisation techniques.
He was also leading a project to create a digital twin application using Bentley Systems’ iTwin platform, managing the project from conception to delivery.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor's in Civil and Structural Engineering
Fun Facts
• Loves the outdoors, especially hiking in the Lake district or Yorkshire Dales.
• Plays Rugby sevens in summer and boulders throughout the year.
• Avid Foodie, will spend most Sundays in the kitchen and use any excuse for a nice meal out.
• Speaks English, German and a bit of French.
What Drives Him

Jonathan co-founded Laminar with a big interest in how to develop and implement technological solutions to help deliver better projects. With a background as a construction engineer and strong software development skills, he's uniquely placed to bridge the knowledge gap between tech and construction. Aside from his consulting work, he's overseeing our digital applications ventures with the aim to provide simple and effective tools that replace paper and Excel-based processes.
Backstory and Achievements

Originally from Australia, he's also lived and worked in Spain and the UK. He has been a construction engineer and planning manager on public infrastructure projects ranging from £1 million to £1 billion.
Before starting Laminar he worked for organisations such as Hochtief, Volker Fitzpatrick, Macmahon Holdings, Ertech and Construction Engineers Australia.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Civil Engineering with Honours
• Full Stack Web Development, Data Modelling and Analytics
• Lean Construction Institute
• SMSTS
Fun Facts
• Jonathan speaks English, Spanish and Catalan.
• He enjoys motorcycling, personal development, and software development.
What Drives Him

Having spent several years working for a construction claims consultancy in a planning capacity, Jonathon strongly believes in the importance of clear, concise and consistent communication that is adapted to the recipient.

He enjoys finding new ways to communicate project data in a manner that encourages the engagement of the project team, increases workflow efficiency and benefits project delivery, as well as protecting the client’s interests.
Backstory and Achievements
Originally from the UK, Jonathon has lived in 3 countries across Europe and the Middle East, but he settled in London eight years ago.

Jonathon has spent most of this time working as a project planner for consultancies. In his consultancy roles he's worked with specialist cladding, groundworks, infrastructure and concrete frame sub-contractors. He's also worked with main contractors and on consultancy-managed projects. In his previous role, he worked for a claims consultancy on projects both in the UK and the USA.

This broad range of disciplines and clients has given him a strong technical knowledge of construction processes, best practice planning techniques and the ability to quickly understand and adapt to clients’ requirements.
Formal Qualifications
• Master's in Civil and Architectural Engineering
Fun Facts
• Jonathon takes part in triathlons, with the ambition to one day do an Ironman.
• He's a self-taught, amateur woodworker.
• He's interested in many sports and is currently getting into the virtual cycling racing world.
Coming soon
What Drives Him

Kautsar is driven by a passion for empowering the people around him. His enthusiasm for fostering positive interactions in the workplace, combined with his technical expertise in developing and delivering data-driven solutions, has enabled him to help both individuals and organisations make better decisions. His natural curiosity about people has also allowed him to connect with individuals from all walks of life.
Backstory and Achievements

Kautsar was born in Indonesia, studied and worked in Australia, and now resides in the UK. Throughout his career, he has been entrusted with delivering projects crucial for growing key strategic accounts for the companies he has worked with. He has successfully executed projects across various data platforms and has developed highly praised 10-hour Power BI classes for corporate students. Additionally, Kautsar has utilised data to address challenges across different functions including building sustainability, project logistics, and operational assets.
Formal Qualifications
• Master of Environmental Engineering
• Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering (Hons)
Fun Facts
• His wife loves his Shakira impression
• Loves snorkeling and spearfishing

What Drives Him

Positive reactions and good relations improve his work. Kerem believes in working in peace and generating incredible outcomes. He can handle tight schedules and manage time in a peaceful environment more easily.
Backstory and Achievements

He graduated from the Civil Engineering Department at METU, Ankara. He has been working in construction management since he graduated. He worked at several companies on various projects in different countries. In project management, he has experienced over Ten years.
Formal Qualifications
• Knowledgeable in scheduling. Good user of Primavera P6, MS Office.
• Knowledgeable in cost management and contract management.
• Organizing and coordinating ability of teams good relationship with Client.
Fun Facts
• He loves to spend time with his family. He loves football and swimming.
• He loves to go to the theatre.
What Drives Him

Mark Kevin is driven by challenges and sees them as opportunities for growth, innovation, and continuous improvement. He is passionate about finding practical and innovative solutions that help deliver successful projects and create lasting value. He values collaboration, enjoys learning from diverse experiences and is equally passionate about mentoring and sharing knowledge with the next generation of professionals.
Backstory and Achievements

Mark Kevin started his professional journey with one of the leading construction companies in the Philippines, where he began as a Cadet Engineer a and steadily progressing into senior planning roles before eventually leading the Planning Department. In addition to his contractor side experience, he has also worked for internationally based companies.

With years of industry experience, he has developed strong expertise in construction planning, scheduling and project controls for large-scale developments across the Philippines, Australia, and Taiwan. His project experience spans mixed-use developments, high-rise residential buildings, land development works, office buildings, hotels and chemical storage terminal facilities.

Throughout his career, he has been involved in project planning and monitoring, schedule development, stakeholder coordination, and supporting teams in achieving efficient and timely project delivery.
Formal Qualifications
• Licensed Civil Engineer
• Licensed Master Plumber
• Accredited Materials Engineer - I
• Completed academic units for Master of Science in Construction Management
Fun Facts

Outside of work, Mark Kevin enjoys exploring new destinations and gaining insights from different cultures and experiences. He is passionate about camping and spending time in nature and he also enjoys watching anime series and reading manga.
What Drives Him

Khidar is a dedicated and proactive project manager with a strong background in the design and construction phases of projects. He's passionate about delivering projects on time, within budget, and exceeding quality expectations. With his creative and analytical mindset, Khidar thinks beyond boundaries and strives for innovative solutions. He's committed to data-driven decision-making and leveraging all available tools to drive project delivery.
Backstory and Achievements

Originally from India, Khidar has gained valuable experience in the construction industry in both the UK and the UAE. He has worked as a project manager in London, managing multiple commercial housing and super luxury residential projects. His leadership and organisational skills contributed to a significant increase in client satisfaction through the adoption of cloud-based project management software. ‍

Prior to his experience in the UK, Khidar worked on large-scale commercial and real estate projects in Dubai valued at around £100 million. Khidar demonstrated exceptional project planning and coordination skills, resulting in activities being consistently ahead of schedule. He effectively managed multiple teams and maintained strict quality control standards throughout all project activities. With a strong focus on safety, Khidar ensured zero accident events by implementing comprehensive safety protocols and fostering a culture of health, safety, and environmental awareness.
Formal Qualifications
• MSc (Eng) International Construction Management and Engineering
• Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM®)
• Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
Fun Facts
• Khidar enjoys cooking and trying out different cuisines.
• He's also passionate about road trips and travelling and finds solace in nature, especially beaches.
What Drives Her

Kirsty strives to make things happen, get things moving, unblock stuck things, and make project life easier for everyone involved. She works hard to ensure strong working relationships whilst being approachable and empathetic. She wants projects to be memorable for the right reasons and to make a positive difference in everything she does.
Backstory and Achievements

Kirsty comes from a Construction background, undertaking a degree in construction management whilst working part-time for a small Lincoln-based construction firm. She has extensive experience in project fields, from Town Centre redevelopments (Witney, Oxfordshire) to sustainable innovation projects (M&S Plan A, Ellesmere Port). Kirsty took a segway into railway, first learning all about operations and management of the railway, eventually moving back into construction-related projects within the railway environment. There she would build a close working relationship with Network Rail, Local Councils and the DfT by delivering many small and large-scale projects through a team of project managers to jointly bid and secure funding through transforming cities and levelling up funding.
Formal Qualifications
• BSC Hons in Construction Management
• MCIOB charters
• Prince 2 Practitioner
• SMSTS
• ACIRO member (Chartered Institute of Railway Operators)
Fun Facts
• She likes to make birthday cakes for each of her children, although the requests are getting more elaborate as the years go on (she had to take an entire day off work for the last one!)
• She has a puppy called ‘Loki’ who lives up to his namesake and is known as the dog of mischief and will occasionally appear on the teams calls.
What Drives Him

Kris gets his drive from being involved with projects that have a positive impact on the end user's lives. He believes that digitalisation is the way forward for the industry. He has been encouraged by what he's seen over the last decade and is excited by what is still to come.
Backstory and Achievements

Kris started his career in construction when a local tier-one construction company placed adverts in his school looking for trainee engineers. Kris applied, got an interview and subsequently got the job!

Since then, Kris has worked for a number of tier-one and two contractors, giving him the opportunity to work on a variety of major Infrastructure schemes as an integral part of the project management team.
Formal Qualifications
• HNC in Civil Engineering
• NVQ Level 6 in Construction Contracting
• Professionally Qualified Civil Engineer (Engtech - Institution of Civil Engineers)
• SMSTS
Fun Facts

• Kris, intrigued by his unusual surname, did a bit of research and found that it originates from sometime around the year 1066, and is an “occupational” name for someone who drinks large quantities of ale.
• He enjoys days out with his young family, especially trips to the sea side.
What Drives Him

Always excited for new learning opportunities and environments, Lamberto joined Laminar to expand his horizon to an international level. He's experienced in project controls and likes to help projects achieve timely delivery. He believes that proper planning, monitoring, coordination, and commitment are key elements in project management.
He loves working and exchanging ideas with passionate people. He believes that teamwork truly makes the dream work.
Backstory and Achievements

Born and raised in the Philippines, his passion for construction led him to be a planning and control engineer where he handled various types of projects such as high-rise residential buildings, mid-rise condominiums, housing projects, a cinema fit-out, temple, and commercial buildings.

Before joining Laminar, he worked as a lead planner for Philippines’ largest construction company where he gained experience in project planning, scheduling, monitoring, revenue variance analysis, earned value management, and others.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Civil Engineering with Honours
• Master of Science in Construction Management
Fun Facts
• He loves to travel and learn about culture, traditions, and food.
• He's a tennis fan who doesn’t know how play tennis, so he plays Badminton instead.
• He enjoys cooking, and watching movies/series.
What Drives Him

Lampros is a civil engineer with a deep interest in the digital transformation of the construction industry through innovation and better information management. Sharing a strong passion in BIM and digital engineering, he firmly believes that the production of structured data, coupled with enhanced collaboration and transparency during the whole project life cycle, is the key to success.
Backstory and Achievements

Lampros comes from Greece where he finished his studies in civil engineering and took his first professional steps in the construction industry. He then moved to the UK to study BIM and follow his dream of digitising the construction industry. Since then, he has worked in BIM roles for main contractors and has experienced first-hand how digital technologies can improve the delivery of construcion projects.
Formal Qualifications
• Master's in Civil Engineering
• MSc in Building Information Modelling in Design, Construction and Operation
Fun Facts
• Lampros speaks Greek, English and German.
• He loves travelling and exploring new places.
• He enjoys watching and playing basketball. He's an NBA fan!
What Drives Her

As a people person, Laura facilitates people’s ability to connect with each other so they can live their lives to the fullest. For that, she focuses on the most sustainable, effective and impactful methods, leading her to always look for new opportunities to try something different to add to her knowledge bank.
Backstory and Achievements

When still a child, Laura thought engineering meant building things – literally. In another life, she would have become a bricklayer, but instead she stuck with civil engineering, completing a year abroad in Spain to get her Spanish to a proficient level. As a site engineer, she has worked on big projects in the Thames Tideway Tunnel and at Heathrow airport. Venturing into the digital, her focus was within the environmental sector, creating an M365-based automated waste management system and developing and implementing a process for estimating company-wide carbon emissions.
Formal Qualifications
• MEng Civil Engineering with a Year Abroad
• APM Project Fundamentals Qualification
Fun Facts
• Laura is a keen puzzler! You’ll struggle to find her leaving the house without her trusty pocket sudoku!
What Drives Her

Lauren is a driven individual that prides herself on attention to detail but also loves to understand the bigger picture. She has an entrepreneurial spirit, looking for ways to grow and evolve businesses as well as herself and those around her. Others have relied on Lauren to ‘get stuff done’ and she prides herself on her communication skills. She is motivated by building relationships, identifying skills in others to create a successful team.
Backstory and Achievements

Born in Milton Keynes (home of concrete cows and roundabouts!) Lauren moved to Leicestershire, to secure a job and love, realising she didn’t want to become a Quantity Surveyor and pursued a career in Planning. Starting her Planning career on housing refurbishment projects in deprived areas of the East Midlands, she moved into the Power sector, then Rolling Stock and Civils & infrastructure. It’s been a mix!

Highlights of Lauren’s career so far have been working on the design of the Crossrail/Elisabeth Line Rolling Stock, being involved in some interesting delay claims and securing a partnership with a commercial organisation that led to winning multiple contracts and frameworks.
Formal Qualifications

Lauren studied Quantity Surveying & Construction Commercial Management at Nottingham Trent University. Lauren has completed an APM Introductory Certificate and ILM Leadership Management Courses. She is also a Mental Health First Aider.
Fun Facts

Lauren loves to travel with her favourite destinations to date being the Maldives and Croatia. She has a 6 year old daughter and 6 year old dog, Solomon who sleeps minimum 20hrs per day! During COVID lockdown alongside her husband, set up a rum distillery which her husband manages – happy to supply Thirsty Thursdays! Lauren danced from age 3-18 years and is soon to be dusting off her dance shoes to return to some adult classes!
What Drives Him

Passionate about problem-solving and learning, Liam is driven by the challenge of transforming complex engineering ideas into tangible infrastructure. His motivation stems from an appreciation for well-executed projects and the lasting impact they have on communities. Liam thrives in dynamic environments, constantly seeking opportunities to learn, improve, and contribute to quality infrastructure development.
Backstory and Achievements

Originally from North Queensland, Australia, Liam has built a strong foundation in civil engineering, specialising in the design and construction of complex water and wastewater infrastructure projects. His experience spans both design consultancy and construction management, allowing him to see projects through from initial inception to execution on-site.

After moving to Germany in 2023, Liam secured a role with an engineering construction firm, where he gained firsthand experience in the European engineering industry while navigating the challenges of a new language. This transition broadened his perspective, deepening his understanding of international engineering practices and strengthening his adaptability in challenging environments.
Formal Qualifications
• Bachelor of Civil/Structural Engineering with Honours
Fun Facts

Liam enjoys all kinds of outdoor activities, from hiking and camping, to spending time on the water fishing.
